data.text:
Printed `Utdrag ur Församlingsboken för` handwritten Degerfors; Vesterbottens län; den31/12 1900; sida145. Contract handwritten wording remains reserved at low resolution (not used as search key).

Column1 `By eller lägenhet (qvarter eller rote i stad). ... Namn (fullständigt) å hvarje person; familjeställning ...; ... icke döpt.` contains locality Buberget and the row names/roles below. Column2 `Yrke (tjenst, näringsfång). Stam (främmande). Lyte ...` contains only father's Bonde in relevant rows. Column3/4 `Födelse- / år. / ort (församling i län eller i stad).` own year and own ditto for locality. Columns5–12 `Ogift m q / Gift m q / Enkling m / Enka q / Frånskild m q` have only indicated diagonal marks, other cells blank. Final column `Trosbekännelse (främmande). Utträde ur svenska kyrkan. Nationalitet (främmande). Frånvarande.` blank for all seven. Its blank is not proof of absence of belief/nationality/disability.

| Person/role in column1 | Yrke | År | Ort | Explicit status mark |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Anders Jonsson | Bonde |39| ditto to Förs. = Degerfors | Enkling m |
| s. Jonas Edvard | blank |71| ditto | Ogift m |
| s. Anders | blank |76| ditto | Ogift m |
| d. Hildur Charlotta | blank |78| ditto | Ogift q |
| s. Karl Magnus | blank |80| ditto | Ogift m |
| d. Hanna Matilda | blank |82| ditto | Ogift q |
| s. Oskar Rudolf | blank |85| ditto | Ogift m |

Left `1` and bracket group these seven as one family; this is not a unique family-id1 for the whole parish. Their births expand to1839/1871/1876/1878/1880/1882/1885; original has no day/month. Children have no written patronymic/occupation. All fields above have been checked for the whole group; no independent signature/marginal note relates to the target household.

data.body:
Retain seven-person household P0065, P0068, P0069, P0070, P0071, P0072, P0073. P0066 deceased wife belongs only to comparison context: C0402 does not name her or give deathdate. Source is a parish-book extract, hence dependent chain, not independent confirmation of its parent series. Widowhood at1900 is compatible with stronger exact death1898 and does not replace it. Preserve1839 vs earlier birthday history on father; source only says year39. Full-reading/new transcription and bounded adoption of seven own rows may be added; no new relations, identity status changes, direct military claims or continuous residence. Explicit own Ogift m/q supports existing sex/status claims. Father's Bonde is his own title only; do not distribute occupation to children.

HildurCharlotta1878 and HannaMatilda1882 remain distinct persons. `Matilda` is source form without h; current displayMathilda may remain historical synthesis with other records. Existing surname/family linkage comes from other household-chain evidence, not an unstated surname in these child cells.
Fullgruppen består av Anders och sex barn; fullfältsavskriften dokumenterar samtliga egna markeringar.
